jobs.description: Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: OperationsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.03.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.03.2026Stellennummer: MER0003ZHRArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOAs the FinTech hub of Mercedes‑Benz, we connect the world of mobility with the world of payments. Our mission is simple: Transform transactions into the best possible customer experience — inside the car and beyond.What does that mean in practice? We make our customers’ lives easier by allowing them to pay for Mercedes-Benz goods and services across the entire customer lifecycle: from the purchase phase (initial financing/leasing rate, online reservation payments or down payments to full vehicle payments) through the usage phase (car-related services like fueling, charging or Digital Extras or the e-Vignette from the Mercedes-Benz Store) all the way to the retention phase (early contract settlement).ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay as a platform was launched in 2018 and is now live in 45+ markets across the globe, playing a central role in the digital business model of Mercedes‑Benz.We enable payments across all customer touchpoints, no matter where the customers are: via app, web, at the Point of Sale and even the car itself. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Stuttgart, Berlin and Singapore.Our solutions enable:- Digital Extras & subscriptions- Mobility services like fueling and charging- e-Commerce (ATC)- Online vehicle sales and full vehicle payment (in selected markets)- In-car payments- LoyaltyOUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than staying stuck because of unexpected roadblocks.In short: How we work is strongly based on our values of collaboration: Trust, innovation, responsibility, team spirit and belonging.Since we are still building new processes and products alongside our existing ones, everyone has the opportunity to shape our success – from day one!Are you ready to rethink how the world pays for mobility? Join us and help shape the future of payments!YOUR DAY AT GLANCE- You will collaborate in a dynamic, innovation-driven environment where your experience and hands-on attitude are valued- You will set up and maintain our AWS cloud infrastructure, align them with best-practice standards using infrastructure as code, and support the rollout of new payment products and services from an infrastructure perspective- You will support releases and ensure the reliable operation of CI/CD pipelines, including up-to-date compliance and security checks for our builds and deployments- You will further develop our data pipeline and integrate it with other systems- You will leverage Datadog features to monitor changes to our infrastructure- You will contribute to IT Operations activities during the rollout of products to new markets and use cases- You will collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions and contribute to AI-based IT Operations solutions at Mercedes pay- You will play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platformQualifikationenWHAT WE EXPECT- You have a strong passion for IT and bring an open-minded, highly motivated attitude- You have strong solution-oriented, problem-solving, and analytical skills- You are proficient in cloud service architecture best practices and have experience writing infrastructure as code- You are proficient in Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm, and have experience in software development (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and the Atlassian toolchain- You have successfully completed a relevant degree in Computer Science or have equivalent professional experience- You are willing to participate in an on-call rotation- You have knowledge of IT security best practices and common standards- You are fluent in business English and technical EnglishWHAT WE OFFER- Modern and dynamic work environment- Flexible and mobile working- Attractive fitness offer- Numerous employee discounts- Excellent infrastructureThis is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedespay GmbH: career_mercedespay@mercedes-benz.comBenefits- Barriere­frei­heit- Coaching- Betriebs­arzt- Mit­arbeiter Events- Mit­arbeiter­rabatte möglich- Mit­arbeiter­beteili­gung möglich- Mit­arbeiter­handy möglich- Essens­zulagen- Gesund­heits­maß­nahmen- Hybrides Arbeiten möglich- Lebens­langes Lernen- Betrieb­liche Alters­ver­sorgung- Park­platz- Gute An­bindung- Flexible Arbeits­zeit möglichKontaktMarta Bredfeldt AcevedoEmail: Marta.Bredfeldt@mercedes-benz.comOtto-Braun-Strasse 7810249 Berlin

cecava, a biopharmaceutical immuno-oncology company based in Tübingen (Germany) currently preparing to conduct first clinical trials, is searching for an experiencedBioinformatics (f/m/d)in full timececava is developing personalized cancer immunotherapies derived from tumor-specific mutations that give rise to neoepitopes. The successful candidate will guide the bioinformatics team in developing, validating and documenting bioinformatic pipelines in compliance with GxP regulations supporting their full life cycle management and use in early- and late-stage clinical trials.Your field of responsibility- Provide guidance to the bioinformatics team in developing, validating, documenting and refining computational pipelines that support drug design and manufacturing decisions in early- and late-stage clinical trials- Ensure the full Life Cycle Management of computational pipelines and novel machine learning models is in line with pharmaceutical industry best practice and current US, EU and international guidelines (e.g. FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH E6, GAMP5)- Oversee and actively participate in clinical operations of the group, including running pipelines to support ongoing clinical trials- Support the company in establishing and maintaining a GxP-compliant IT-infrastructure- Lead and further develop the bioinformatics team – mentoring and supporting the professional development of team members - Represent the bioinformatics team in cross-functional projects and regulatory interactionsOur expectations- Master's or PhD degree in Bioinformatics, Informatics, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related field- At least 3 years of relevant experience working in a regulated environment (preferably GxP) in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or a similarly regulated industry. - Demonstrated experience developing, validating and documenting software for a GxP-regulated environment and according to current regulations (preferably GAMP5)- Sound knowledge of Software Life-Cycle Management according to pharmaceutical industry best practice and current regulations (including versioning, code review, change & risk management)- Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL is expected (knowledge in R, Java, or JavaScript is a plus)- Knowledge in the creation of User Interfaces is a plus- Ideally, experience in conceptualizing, programming, training and testing of ML models - Experience with the development of Next-Generation Sequencing analysis pipelines is a plus- Ideally, a biology background, preferably in oncology, immunology, or immuno-oncology- Leadership experience, including mentoring, managing and developing bio/informatics teams- Excellent organizational, communication and presentation skills, including a good working knowledge of German and English (verbally and in writing)Our offer- An exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of a disruptive technology for the benefit of cancer patients- Work within a dedicated team in an entrepreneurial, innovative, and open-minded working atmosphere- Flat hierarchies and easy access to all company functions- Free drinks and fresh fruits- Job bike and Job ticket (Deutschlandticket)Your applicationPlease send your complete application (including cover letter, CV, certificates, expected availability date, salary expectations, a complete list of publications and 2-3 references) by email and in one PDF document to jobs@cecava.com.We look forward to receiving your application

The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing biomedical data and for developing, validating, and refining computational pipelines for Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) analyses and neoepitope prediction and selection, to support cecava’s clinical trials.Your field of responsibility- Together with the bioinformatics team, develop, validate, and refine computational pipelines for NGS analyses and neoepitope prediction & selection - Support the documentation, testing and validation of computational pipelines in line with internal quality and regulatory standards- Run bioinformatics pipelines in a GxP-regulated environment to support clinical trials- Organize biomedical data (including database construction) and conduct statistical analyses and visualizations- Strengthen the bioinformatics unit of the company and work within an interdisciplinary teamOur expectations- Degree in Bioinformatics (MSc or PhD; jobs.occupation: Internship within Commodity Management for IT Infrastructure (d/f/m) (Fachwirt/in - Einkauf/Bachelor Professional in Procurement)
jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support the Commodity Procurement IT Infrastructure, Airbus Defence and Space is offering anInternship within Commodity Management for IT Infrastructure (d/f/m)Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Buyer/Commodity Manager for IT Infrastructure (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us at Commodity Procurement IT Infrastructure as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn- Start: 01.04.2027- Duration: 6 monthsAs an intern (d/f/m) you will acquire an in-depth insight into divisional sourcing for IT Infrastructure for products and external customers.The internship covers three main learning areas: IT Demand Management and Standardisation, which involves learning how Airbus aggregates and standardises IT demands for complexity reduction and procurement efficiency; Supplier Evaluation and Development, focusing on the rigorous assessment and continuous improvement of the supplier base; and Strategic Supplier Landscape Development, where the intern contributes to the long-term evolution of the supplier base by analysing market trends, managing risk, and developing resilient sourcing strategies.By engaging in these activities, you will receive practical exposure to the full lifecycle of commodity management, from initial demand planning and strategic sourcing to ongoing supplier relationship management and development within a leading global aerospace and defence context.Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilities- Assisting in the identification and gathering of purchasing potentials.- Support and launch RFI (Request for Information) /RFP (Request for Proposal) events (via the Airbus Defence & Space procurement tool) and follow up the ordering process.- Preparation of negotiation results and supplier proposals.- Assisting in the creation of the respective commodity- and supplier strategies.- Special tasks. e.g. project tasks to support team leaders.Desired skills and qualifications- Enrolled full time student (d/f/m) within Economics, Business Administration, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering or similar field of study- Very good Google Workspace and MS Office knowledge- Discretion mandatory - strong focus on accuracy- Fluency in English is mandatory- German / French / Spanish would be a plusPlease upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.Take your career to a new level and applyonline (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Team Lead Applied AI Engineering / Forward-Deployed AI 2 Lead (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: Job Posting: Team Lead Applied AI Engineering / Forward-Deployed AI 2 LeadLocation: GlobalDepartment: DI AUT IT AIDA AI 2Job Grade: non senior management / ÜT fähigMode of Employment: Permanent / Full-time & Part-timeGRIP: IT-IT-INTEC-TL999 / IT Team LeaderExternal Posting?: NoHiring Manger: Belen BandieraThe official start of this Leadership role is planned for October 1st 2026. As part of our transformation towards ONE Tech Company it plays a key role in shaping the future of our organization.What we offer you- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions- Diverse health and wellness offerings- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of SiemensSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and devleopment opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.Transform the everyday.In this role, you will lead a team of Applied AI Engineers working closely with Siemens DI functions to identify, design, deliver, and operate impactful AI solutions. You will help stakeholders understand what is possible with AI, translate domain challenges into concrete impactful use cases, and guide solutions from early discovery through prototype, MVP, and production readiness.How you will make an Impact with us- Lead a team of Applied AI Engineers delivering impactful AI solutions for Siemens DI business functions.- Partner with domain/functions experts and business stakeholders to transform internal processes with AI.- Translate business pain points or business process into clear AI use cases, technical solution concepts, value KPIs, and delivery plans.- Guide AI solutions from consulting and PoV/prototype through MVP and production-ready operation.- Provide technical leadership on AI architecture, software engineering, evaluation, monitoring, and security.- Coach AI engineers in both technical excellence and stakeholder-facing consulting.- Build trust with senior stakeholders by explaining AI opportunities, limitations, risks, and value potential.- Ensure AI solutions are robust, secure, maintainable, compliant, and measurable.- Collaborate with DI IT, HUB, platform teams, cybersecurity, legal, worker-council stakeholders, product teams, and domain organizations.What you bring- 5+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, or software engineering.- 2+ years of experience leading AI engineers/ Data Scientist, or complex cross-functional technical software initiatives.- Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and delivering AI/ML solutions cloud first, including evaluation, guardrails, and observability.- Strong software engineering foundation, including Python, APIs, data pipelines, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and production operations in the cloud.- Ability to communicate effectively with both executives and AI engineers.- Strong business-value orientation and ability to define measurable business outcomes and drive the technical implantation to measure them after go live.- Experience in enterprise environments with security, compliance, data governance, and integration constraints.- High ownership, pragmatic judgment, and the ability to create clarity in ambiguous situations.- In this role, your focus will be on sales (configuration, pricing, quoting, sales ops & performance) related business functions and SHERPA related use cases.You are the right person if- You can walk into a domain conversation, understand the real process, and identify where AI could create value.- You are obsessed with creating real measurable impact with AI- You can inspire stakeholders with what is possible, helping them transform the way they work in their departments with AI, while staying grounded in feasibility, data, risk, and measurable impact.- You can guide your team in architecture and challenge engineering decisions.- You enjoy developing people and raising the engineering bar.- You want to build AI solutions that move beyond demos and become sustainable, production-ready capabilities.Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plusYou are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!Please note, this position will be based in the Siemens location where the selected candidate currently is located. The role has been assessed as a level (TL999). The actual compensation range will vary based on work location, applicable salary structure, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Candidates will receive compensation information relevant to their location during the recruitment process in accordance with local legal requirements and Siemens compensation practices. For further information regarding the compensation details that apply to you and your country, please contact the recruiter directly.At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preferenceAbout usSiemens Digital Industries Automation (DI AUT) is one of the world’s leading providers of industrial automation. Our innovative automation portfolio enables companies of all sizes in both the process and discrete manufacturing industries to accelerate their automation—and thus their digital transformation—across the entire value chain. This allows our customers to increase productivity and flexibility and become future-ready through technologies such as software-defined systems and artificial intelligence. Siemens Xcelerator—the open digital business platform—helps to implement this more easily, quickly, and at scale. Together with partners and a broad ecosystem, Siemens supports its customers on their journey toward becoming a Digital Enterprise. otc2026di

jobs.employer_name: Thermo Fisher Scient. Ger. B.V. & Co. KG
jobs.description: Work ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionAt Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Through our PPD® clinical research services, we support clinical trials in more than 100 countries, delivering laboratory, digital and decentralized solutions that help bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.Our goal-driven teams combine and deliver startup activities for the clinical trials, collaborating to improve processes, cycle and flexibility. We partner with our sites, businesses and colleagues around the world to decrease startup timelines and exceed expectations.Why Join PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific?- Work on high-quality, global clinical trials across diverse therapeutic areas- Be part of a stable, well-established organization with long-term career opportunities- Strong collaboration with experienced CTMs and project teams- Clear development pathways (e.g., Senior CRA, Lead CRA, CTM)- Flexible working models that support work-life balance- Permanent employment- Full-time (40 hours/week)Discover Impactful Work:PPD clinical research service`s mission is to improve health. It starts as an idea to cure. It becomes a life saved. All in-between, it’s you! We know that meaningful results not only require the right approach, but also the right people. We invite you to re-imagine health promoting protocols with us, working alongside our dedicated, forward-thinking and upbeat teams.Position Overview:As a Clinical Trial Coordinator, you will provide administrative and technical support to the Project Team.
